headline: Expanse Cools Slightly as Passage Stirs Anew
war_summary: Since the 00:11 edition the pace has eased in the Weathered Expanse yet the wire still centers there, with three changes in the last two hours to 03:16 for fifty-six on the day about Crow's Nest, Wightwalk and Shattered Advance, the map now counting seven Warden holdings and two unheld, with twenty-four-hour losses of 8,096 Colonial and 12,062 Warden still accelerating. Palantine Berm remains brisk with six changes in two hours to 01:56 for thirty-three on the day about The Droll, Leiri Hermanni and the Pippeli Stones, now six Warden to one Colonial. Callahan's Passage has stirred anew with two changes in two hours to 02:57 for thirty-five on the day about Crumbling Post, while Stlican Shelf logs one change in two hours to 02:57 for twenty-eight on the day about Briar and Breaker Town, now one Warden to eight Colonial. Callums Cape records four fresh changes to 02:43 about Scouts Jest. The Nevish Line, Stonecradle and Kuura Strand, busy yesterday, show no change in the past six hours.
